title: Building
summary: Compilers, make and the rest, so builds on push and builds by hand work offline.
consent: A compiler on the box lets anyone with a shell build and run programs here. The builds on push need it.
notes: Kept until removed by default: builds on push need it.
PlatformIO, and protobuf and protoc for Meshtastic's nanopb, are Debian's, checked like every package.

libffi-dev: Meshtastic's ESP32 platform makes a Python environment of its own, and on armv7 PyPI has no wheel for cffi (cryptography needs it), so it is compiled, and needs libffi's headers (found on the Lyra, 2026-10-07).
Also carries a wheelhouse (a newer PlatformIO from PyPI, protobuf and grpcio-tools, as wheels): the fallback when Debian's PlatformIO cannot build, still with no internet. PyPI signs none of them.
